issues.detail: The Hebrew place name בָּרֶד (Bered) is transliterated as 別列人 ('people of Bered'), adding 人 ('people') which is not in the Hebrew; the Hebrew simply says 'between Kadesh and Bered' (בֵין קָדֵשׁ וּבֵין בָּרֶד). The Chinese rendering '別列人之間' implies 'between the people of Bered,' which changes the meaning from a location to a group of people.
